title: Maffeo da Treviglio to Tamas Bakocz, Buda 30 Nov 1490 (MNL OL DL 46150): four pages in secret writing

documents.shelfmark: MNL OL DL 46150 (Q 10, Veghely; Hungaricana charters 228061; catalogue 1235)
documents.route: Buda -> Tamas Bakocz, bishop of Gyor (Latin original with seal)

plaintext.source: none: Hungaricana regest only; no publication found in the 28 Oct 2026 verification

transcription.source: Hungaricana viewer images (orig_1, orig_2 spread of pp. 2-3, orig_3)
transcription.notes: Not transcribed. The viewer's tile requests fail in the built-in browser (CORS) and only 829 px thumbnails are reachable.

system.summary: Italian monoalphabetic-homophonic cipher of letter-like signs, figures and marks, with vowel homophones, nulls, geminate and syllable signs and a small nomenclator.

diacritics.note: Superscript a/e/o/u/t/s, macron, stroke and dot turn a base sign into a syllable or another letter (q^e = re, m^a = sa, m-macron = b).

system.notes: Per Somogyi 2016: 21 letters, 5 nulls, et/in/che signs, 5 geminates, 32 syllable signs, 6 nomenclator entries. Her key is numeric only; glyphs were pinned here via Vestigia 267/268. Unidentified signs remain (q^s+x-bar, a capital-E sign, a wavy null).

solution.what: Read targets/buda1489 (key_R5411.md, Somogyi key, NOTES) and the verification record for catalogue 1235; planned to test key R5411 on DL 46150.

Opened the Hungaricana charter record and viewer (archives.hungaricana.hu/en/charters/view/228061/). Five images: ceteri (colour target), orig_1 (p. 1, 3668x3739), orig_2 (spread of pp. 2-3), orig_3 (p. 4), sigil. The viewer's main pane stays blank: its XHR to the tile CDN is blocked by CORS in this browser and tile URLs are encrypted client-side. Only /tile/thumb (829x512 for the spread) is reachable; no sign is legible at that size. The captcha/proof-of-work was not involved and nothing was bypassed.
Looked at the 829 px thumbnail of the pp. 2-3 spread: about 26 closely written cipher lines per page, no clear text visible; layout only.

outcome.method_basis: No transcription could be made: the image viewer is not usable here, so no key was tested.
outcome.notes: Attempted, open. Blocker is image access (illegible at thumbnail size). Same hand and period as buda1489, so R5411 and Somogyi's key are the first things to test on proper images.

gaps.item: all four cipher pages of DL 46150
gaps.detail: viewer tiles blocked by CORS in the built-in browser; only 829 px thumbnails
